name: Trampled by Light
body:
School evocation [light]; Level druid 5, shaman 5, white necromancer 5

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 60 ft.
Area 60-ft.-line
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half, see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You launch a beam of sunlight from your hand. Each creature in the beam is permanently blinded and takes 4d6 points of damage. Any creatures to which sunlight is harmful or unnatural take double damage. In addition, any creature in the line that fails their Reflex save is knocked prone. A successful Reflex save negates the blindness and prone, and reduces the damage by half.

Any undead in the line instead take 1d6 damage per caster level (maximum 15d6), or half as much on a successful saving throw. This is considered sunlight for such creatures destroyed by sunlight.
